chunks: And whatever is in H from Idris ibn Abdullah al-Qummi, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah have mercy on him—from Saʿd ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khaṭṭab, from Jaʿfar ibn Bashir, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Idris ibn Abdullah ibn Saʿd al-Ashʿari al-Qummi.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father; the immediate source from whom the author narrates
key_terms.إِدْرِيسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْقُمِّيّ: Idris ibn Abdullah al-Qummi, the narrator to whom the chain leads
key_terms.الْأَشْعَرِيِّ الْقُمِّيِّ: al-Ashʿari al-Qummi, a lineage and regional attribution of the narrator
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I narrated it; a transmission formula indicating receipt of the report

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Idris ibn Abdullah al-Qummi in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Idris ibn Abdullah al-Qummi. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission in hadith literature and identifying the intermediaries through whom the narration is received.
